part.twoMotifs.title: Two motifs in a row
part.twoMotifs.summary: A sacrifice works when it prepares a second blow; without it, it is just material given away.
ex.tm.67nDK: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.tm.67nDK.hint: Look for a sacrifice with check that brings the black king to a square where it gets checked again.
ex.tm.67nDK.solution: 16.Rxe7+! The rook captures the bishop with check and draws the king to e7. After 16...Kxe7, 17.Bg5+ gives check and uncovers the attack of the queen on d1 on the queen on d4.
ex.tm.0y0yV: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.tm.0y0yV.hint: Look for a sacrifice that draws the black queen onto the same diagonal as the king.
ex.tm.0y0yV.solution: 17.Rxe5! The rook captures the bishop and draws the queen to e5. After 17...Qxe5, 18.Bf4 pins the queen against the king on b8.
ex.tm.t2rZ1: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.tm.t2rZ1.hint: The black queen and king are on the e-file. Think about how to open it.
ex.tm.t2rZ1.solution: 18.Nxd5! The knight sacrifices itself on the pawn on d5, and the pawn on e6 recaptures and opens the e-file. 19.Re1 pins the queen on e7 against the king on e8.
ex.tm.sbjFq: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.tm.sbjFq.hint: The pawn on e3 is one square from e2, and the bishop on b6 eyes the white king. What stops the blow right now?
ex.tm.sbjFq.solution: 15...Qxd6! The queen captures the knight that was giving check, and the pawn on e5 recaptures. 16...e2+ gives a discovered check from the bishop on b6, and the pawn attacks the queen on d1 and the rook on f1.
ex.tm.0IOmf: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.tm.0IOmf.hint: Look for a sacrifice that brings the black queen to a square where it can be pinned.
ex.tm.0IOmf.solution: 18.Nxf7! The knight sacrifices itself on f7 and draws the queen. 19.Bg6 pins the queen against the king on e8. After 19...O-O, which takes the king out of the pin, 20.Bxf7+ captures the queen.
ex.tm.vNJht: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.tm.vNJht.hint: Look for a sacrifice with check that brings the black queen to a square your knight can reach.
ex.tm.vNJht.solution: 17.Rxe6+! The rook captures the pawn with check and draws the queen to e6. After 17...Qxe6, 18.Nxg7+ is a fork: check to the king and an attack on the queen. After 18...Kf7, 19.Nxe6 captures the queen.
ex.tm.kwLJm: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.tm.kwLJm.hint: Look for a capture that brings the white rook to a square your queen can attack with check.
ex.tm.kwLJm.solution: 17...Rxc1! The rook captures the bishop and draws the rook on a1 to c1. After 18.Rxc1, 18...Qg5+ is a double attack: check to the king and an attack on the rook on c1. After 19.Ng3, 19...Qxc1 captures the rook.
ex.tm.pziyc: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.tm.pziyc.hint: The pawn on e6 defends d5. Look for a way to remove it.
ex.tm.pziyc.solution: 17.Qxf5! The queen captures the knight that was giving check, and the pawn on e6 recaptures. Without the pawn on e6, d5 is undefended: 18.Nxd5+ is a fork, with check to the king and an attack on the queen on b6. After 18...Kd8, 19.Nxb6 captures the queen.
part.bishopSacH7.title: Sacrifice on h7
part.bishopSacH7.summary: The Greek gift works with bishop, knight and queen ready; a single defender is enough to make the idea fail.
ex.gg.Rzw9g: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.Rzw9g.hint: Check the three attacking pieces: who reaches h7, who reaches g5 and who reaches the h-file.
ex.gg.Rzw9g.solution: 17.Bxh7+! The bishop captures the pawn with check and draws the king out. After 17...Kxh7, 18.Ng5+ gives check and clears the way for the queen to reach the h-file.
ex.gg.WyxVT: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.WyxVT.hint: The pawn on h7 has only the king as a defender, and no black knight reaches f6.
ex.gg.WyxVT.solution: 13.Bxh7+! The bishop captures the pawn with check and draws the king out. After 13...Kxh7, 14.Ng5+ gives check, and the queen on e2 passes through f3 to reach the h-file.
ex.gg.mdWaC: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.mdWaC.hint: The pawn on e5 takes the f6 square away from the black knights. Check whether the attack has the three pieces.
ex.gg.mdWaC.solution: 14.Bxh7+! The bishop captures the pawn with check and draws the king out. After 14...Kxh7, 15.Ng5+ gives check and clears the way for the queen on d1 to reach the h-file.
ex.gg.7fdjf: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.gg.7fdjf.hint: The pawn on h2 has only the king as a defender. Also see what the rook on f5 is hiding.
ex.gg.7fdjf.solution: 18...Bxh2+! The bishop sacrifices itself with check and draws the king to h2. After 19.Kxh2, 19...Rh5+ gives check and, by leaving f5, uncovers the attack of the queen on g6 on the queen on d3: Black wins the queen.
ex.gg.rFFAW: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.rFFAW.hint: Think about the three attacking pieces and the order in which they come in.
ex.gg.rFFAW.solution: 17.Bxh7+! The bishop captures the pawn with check. After 17...Kxh7, 18.Ng5+ gives check, and after 18...Kg8, 19.Qh5 threatens mate on h7.
ex.gg.2tXCd: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.2tXCd.hint: There is no knight to go to g5 here. Which other piece reaches the h-file with check?
ex.gg.2tXCd.solution: 17.Bxh7+! The bishop on f5 captures the pawn with check. After 17...Kxh7, 18.Rh3+ brings the rook to the h-file with check, and after 18...Kg8, 19.Qh5 threatens mate on h7 and h8.
ex.gg.jos4O: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.gg.jos4O.hint: The pawn on h2 has only the king as a defender. This time the queen reaches the h-file first.
ex.gg.jos4O.solution: 16...Bxh2+! The bishop captures the pawn with check. After 17.Kxh2, 17...Qh4+ brings the queen to the h-file with check, and after 18.Kg1, 18...Ng4 threatens mate on h2.
ex.gg.JrAjY: Play as Black and find the best move.
ex.gg.JrAjY.hint: After the sacrifice, the queen gives checks. Look for the check that also attacks another white piece.
ex.gg.JrAjY.solution: 17...Bxh2+! The bishop captures the pawn with check and draws the king out. After 18.Kxh2, 18...Qh4+ gives check, and after 19.Kg1, 19...Qxd4+ is a double attack: check to the king and an attack on the rook on a1 and the bishop on d3.
ex.gg.kC264: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.kC264.hint: The knight on c3 attacks your queen and the rook on d1. See what the rook is looking at behind the bishop on d3.
ex.gg.kC264.solution: 15.Bxh7+! The bishop captures the pawn with check and uncovers the attack of the rook on d1 on the queen on d4. After 15...Kxh7, 16.Qh5+ takes the queen out of the knight's attack with check, and after 16...Kg8, 17.Rxd4 captures the queen.
ex.gg.PJLIv: Play as White and find the best move.
ex.gg.PJLIv.hint: Before sacrificing, check what defends h7 and which pieces are under attack on both sides.
ex.gg.PJLIv.solution: 15.Nxd4! The knight recaptures on d4. Taking on h7 at once did not work: the knight on f6 recaptures. After 15...Qxd4, 16.Bxh7+ gives check and uncovers the attack of the queen on d1 on the queen on d4. After 16...Nxh7, 17.Qxd4 captures the queen.
